<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors in series between terminals A and X1, with one resistor twice the value of the other. Let the smaller resistor be R = 2.222 Ω, then the larger is 2R = 4.444 Ω, giving a total series resistance of 6.667 Ω, matching the measurement. The topology can be expressed with an intermediate node B connecting the two series resistors.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1":2.222,"R2":4.444},"connections":[["A","B","R1"],["B","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
